name: Better Mix
description: Every mix Spotify makes for you, rebuilt daily without the songs you already play: popular tracks by artists you don't listen to, shown on Home in place of Spotify's rows.

name: Better Mix Pages
description: Optional add-on for the Better Mix extension: a playlist-style page for every mix, with tracklist, shuffle, search and sort. Needs a one-time spicetify apply.

name: Hide Announcements
description: Hides Spotify's promos, upsells and banners — and tells you when it does. Includes a self-test so you can verify it works, and a log of everything it has caught.

name: Sleep Timer
description: Pause Spotify after a set time. Presets up to 2 hours, a custom duration, and an end-of-track option. Fades the volume down before pausing and restores it afterwards.
